formats.label: Ignition · 6-handed · NL200
formats.note: 6-max ring. Ignition's rake table for stakes above NL25 (checked 2026-09-13): 5% of the pot, cap by players DEALT $1 / $2 / $3 / $4 at 2 / 3 / 4-5 / 6+. formats.label: Ignition · heads-up SnG turbo · $10 winner-take-all
formats.note: 1500 chips, 5-min levels, winner-take-all (chipEV = $EV, no ICM); the fee is paid at entry so no per-hand rake. Per-PLAYER antes and the small blind by level, verified against hand #5333182787 (2026-09-03): L1 15/25 a5 (sb 0.6bb!, ante 0.2bb), L2 25/50 a10, L3 50/100 a15, L4 75/150 a25 (ante 0.1667bb), L5 100/200 a30, L6 150/300 a45, L7 200/400 a60. Effective stack never exceeds 1500/bb, so a depth fixes its level: >30bb is level 1 only. VERIFIED: level 1 (the hand, 3 Sep) and level 2 (25/50 ante 10, read off the client by Brady 17 Sep = sb 0.5bb, ante 0.2bb/player); levels 3-7 are the published schedule, unconfirmed. Only level 1 is solved so far; level 2 (15-30bb, 75 trees) is held by Brady's choice until after the CoinPoker HU run.

formats.label: CoinPoker · dedicated heads-up · $1/$2
formats.note: Dedicated Heads-Up table ladder on coinpoker.com/rake (1 Sep 2026 revision, re-verified 3 Sep): 5% of pot, cap $1.80 = 0.90bb, no flop no drop. ANTE 0.2bb per player (0.4bb dead) CONFIRMED by Brady for $1/$2 on 2026-09-17 ('yeah it's 0.2bb per player ante so 0.4bb total'). Depth ladder 20-150bb with 5bb steps from 80 to 125 (Brady, 17 Sep); the lobby buy-in range is unrecorded. A ring table playing 2-handed is a different format (cap 0.75bb). Splash-pot tables add a flat 0.1bb per pot, not modelled.

formats.label: Ignition · ring table gone heads-up · $1/$2
formats.note: A 6-max ring table with two players left (session 202818, 2026-09-18, hand 9) — not a dedicated HU table. Ignition ring rake measured 2026-09-12: 5% of pot, cap by players DEALT: $1 for 2 dealt = 0.5bb at $1/$2, no flop no drop; no ante; dealer posts the 0.5bb small blind and acts first preflop, last postflop. Depth ladder (Brady, 2026-09-19): 100/125/150, then every 5bb from 95 down to 60, every 10bb to 30, every 5bb below to 10.

formats.label: Ignition · heads-up cash · NL500 ($2.50/$5)
formats.note: Ignition's 2-player cap is a FLAT $1.00 at every stake from $0.10/$0.25 to $10/$20, so at NL500 ($5 big blind) it is 0.20bb - the lowest cap of any format we solve. Two independent sources: the published rake page (verified 2026-07-27) and 21,448 of Brady's own hands measured 2026-09-12 (cap keyed to players DEALT: $1/$2/$3/$4 at 2/3/4-5/6+, same dollar caps at NL100/NL200/NL500). 5% of pot, no flop no drop, both measured. NO ANTE (Ignition cash never has one in anything measured; unlike the CoinPoker dedicated HU tables which ante 0.2bb each) - assumed, not read off a table. Depth ladder 20-150bb with 5bb steps 80-125, reused from the CoinPoker HU run; Brady confirmed the stake is spread 2026-09-19 but the lobby buy-in range is still unrecorded.
